label: Nested facets
help: Panels with nested strips, e.g. SOC over PT: rows = vars(AEBODSYS, AEDECOD).

label: Per-panel scales
help: A different x or y scale for each panel: y = list(scale_y_continuous(...), ...).

label: Markdown text
help: In theme() or labs(): text with **bold**, *italic*, <sup>superscript</sup> (e.g. axis.title.y = element_markdown()).

label: Markdown text box
help: A title or caption that wraps inside a box.

label: Zoomed panel
help: A zoomed-in copy of part of the panel beside it: xlim = c(0, 30).

label: New colour scale
help: Between layers: the layers after it get their own colour scale (and legend).

label: New fill scale
help: Between layers: the layers after it get their own fill scale (and legend).

label: New scale
help: Between layers: a new scale for the aesthetic named (new_scale("size")).
